newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic sees defibrillators gaining ground.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic sees defibrillators gaining ground.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Monday it expects results of a study to accelerate medical market acceptance of implantable defibrillators as the therapy of choice for persons afflicted with lethally rapid heartbeats.

It said the Heart, Lung and Blood Institute of the National Institutes of Health on Monday announced it ended the AVID (Anbtiarrhythmics vs. Implantable Defibrillators) study, which involved a randomized patient population of more than 1,000 persons, 16 months before its contemplated termination date.

According to the study, the risk of death among patients who received implantable defibrillators was nearly 38 percent less than that of those treated with drugs in the first year of their therapies, Medtronic said.
